title: A2-14 · The subordinates: why, why, when, if

blocks.text: A2-14 · The subordinates: why, why, when, if
Lesson overview

I think it's a good idea.I go because they invited me, when I arrive I call you, if you lose, ask for it, before I leave, while I studied, .................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................... In this unit you learn to distinguish ⁧أَنَّ⁩ ( + sentence) from ⁧أَنْ⁩ ( + verb to conjunctiva), to give a cause with ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ , to place the shares in time with ⁧عِنْدَمَا⁩ , ⁧قَبْلَ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧بَيْنَمَا⁩ , and to make a real hypothesis with ⁧إِذَا⁩ + perfect. The context is the choice of travel to Cairo and practical advice before leaving. Two weeks.

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A2 (tag A2-14), script for speech synthesis, session with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. distinguish ⁧أَنَّ⁩ + sentence (facts, opinions) from ⁧أَنْ⁩ + conjunctive (will, necessity, possibility);
2. use ⁧أَنَّ⁩ and ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ with the subject to the prosecution or with a suffix pronoun ( ⁧أَنَّهُ⁩ , ⁧لِأَنَّنِي⁩ );
3. say "when" with ⁧عِنْدَمَا⁩ (and recognize ⁧لَمَّا⁩ , ⁧حِينَ⁩ );
4. build a real condition with ⁧إِذَا⁩ + perfect and the ⁧فَـ⁩ in the second part, also the negative ( ⁧إِذَا لَمْ⁩ …);
5. sort the shares with ⁧قَبْلَ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ⁩ , ⁧بَيْنَمَا⁩ , ⁧لِذٰلِكَ⁩ ;
6. motivate a choice, express an opinion, give advice and instructions with conditions.
Two-week plan.

What to notice. ⁧سَمِعْتُ أَنَّكَ سَتُسَافِرُ⁩ , ⁧أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ فَاسَ أَجْمَلُ⁩ , ⁧أَعْرِفُ أَنَّ لَهْجَتَهُمْ⁩ ...: after the verbs of knowing, hearing, believing comes ⁧أَنَّ⁩ + sentence; the following subject: ⁧أَنَّ⁩ goes to the accusative ( ⁧لَهْجَتَهُمْ⁩ , ⁧فَاسَ⁩ ) or is a suffix ( ⁧أَنَّكَ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّنِي⁩ ). Instead of ⁧قَرَّرْتُ أَنْ أَبْدَأَ⁩ : after decision is taken ⁧أَنْ⁩ + conjunctive (A2-04). ⁧تَقُولُ إِنَّ⁩ : after ... say... is used ⁧إِنَّ⁩ ( A2-19). ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ • because it is not, ⁧عِنْدَمَا أَرْجِعُ⁩ When I return to my place (with the imperfect, for the future), ⁧لَمَّا كُنْتُ⁩ - when I was a girl, ⁧قَبْلَ أَنْ أُسَافِرَ⁩ • before leaving • • ⁧لِذٰلِكَ⁩ For this reason. ⁧الفُصْحَى⁩ • Standard Arabic. ⁧تُشْبِهُ بَعْضَهَا⁩ They were similar (to each other) to each other. ⁧ضِعْتُ⁩ I've lost my way (from ⁧ضَاعَ⁩ , concave: A2-15). blocks.text: The forms with the suffixes: ⁧أَنَّنِي⁩ / ⁧أَنِّي⁩ , ⁧أَنَّكَ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّكِ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّهُ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّهَا⁩ , ⁧أَنَّنَا⁩ , ⁧أَنَّكُمْ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّهُمْ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّهُنَّ⁩ . When the phrase begins with a verb, the suffix is used ⁧أَنَّهُ⁩ It's that he or the neutral suffix. ⁧ـهُ⁩ : ⁧سَمِعْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُغْلَقُ المَكْتَبُ⁩ I have heard that the office will be closed (to be recognized). No vowels ⁧أن⁩ The same is written in the two cases: decides what follows. If after ⁧أن⁩ comes a verb to the imperfect, is ⁧أَنْ⁩ ; if a name or suffix comes, it is ⁧أَنَّ⁩ . The Italian conjunctive. I think it's in Arabic after ⁧أَنَّ⁩ the verb remains at the sign. The Arab conjunctive (A2-04) is only used after ⁧أَنْ⁩ , ⁧لَنْ⁩ , ⁧لِكَيْ⁩ , ⁧حَتَّى⁩ .
3. ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ and the cause

rows: because he is sick · because I am tired

blocks.text: Why? Why... ⁧لِمَاذَا⁩ … ⁧؟⁩ — ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ ... Be careful not to confuse the cause ( ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ + sentence: ... because it is so) with purpose ( ⁧لِـ⁩ / ⁧لِكَيْ⁩ + conjunctive: Other words of the cause to be recognized: ⁧بِمَا أَنَّ⁩ • since it is not ⁧إِذْ⁩ • because it is formal; ⁧وَذٰلِكَ لِأَنَّ⁩ This is because it is (in the news).
4. When: ⁧عِنْدَمَا⁩ , ⁧لَمَّا⁩ , ⁧حِينَ⁩

rows: When I got here, I called you.
When I arrive (I will) I call you.

blocks.text: Two ⁧لَمَّا⁩ . ⁧لَمَّا⁩ + Perfect = when (past); ⁧لَمَّا⁩ + Jussive = not yet (A2-05): ⁧لَمَّا يَصِلْ⁩ It's not here yet. Look at the form of the verb. When is it? ⁧مَتَى؟⁩ is the application; ⁧عِنْدَمَا⁩ introduces a sentence: ⁧مَتَى تَصِلُ؟⁩ — ⁧عِنْدَمَا يَنْتَهِي العَمَلُ⁩ When do you get here? When the job is finished
5. The actual  is: ⁧إِذَا⁩
⁧إِذَا⁩ + perfect, even when the meaning is present or future: ⁧إِذَا وَصَلْتَ مُتَأَخِّرًا⁩ If you're late, it's too late. The second part may be:

rows: If the train is late, we wait.
If you get lost, ask a cop.
If he comes, I'll tell you.
If you have time, the museum is close.

blocks.text: The ⁧فَـ⁩ . It is placed in front of the second part when it does not start with a perfect or simple imperfect: imperative, prohibition, ⁧سَـ⁩ / ⁧سَوْفَ⁩ , ⁧لَنْ⁩ , ⁧قَدْ⁩ , nominal sentence. It translates to a comma. If not. ⁧إِذَا لَمْ⁩ + Judging: ⁧إِذَا لَمْ تَفْهَمْ فَاسْأَلْ⁩ If you don't understand, ask for it. If there is any, if there is any. ⁧إِذَا كَانَ⁩ …: ⁧إِذَا كَانَ هُنَاكَ عَدَّادٌ⁩ If there is a taximeter, ⁧إِذَا كَانَتِ الحَالَةُ خَطِيرَةً⁩ If the situation is serious, please specify: Other to be recognised. ⁧إِنْ⁩ + juxtative (formal, legal and religious texts): ⁧إِنْ تَدْرُسْ تَنْجَحْ⁩ If you study, pass. ⁧لَوْ⁩ + Perfect... ⁧لَـ⁩ + perfect for the unreal hypothesis (ONO-01): ⁧لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي وَقْتٌ لَزُرْتُكَ⁩ If I had time, I'd come and see you. In A2 are only actively used ⁧إِذَا⁩ and ⁧إِذَا لَمْ⁩ .

8. Pronunciation

anna / an. The difference is in the n: double in ⁧أَنَّ⁩ (an-na), simple in ⁧أَنْ⁩ . In ⁧أَنَّهُ⁩ , ⁧أَنَّنِي⁩ the double feels: an-na-hu, an-na-nī. Li-anna. It is pronounced united: li-an-na, li-an-na-hu. iḏā...fa-. The ⁧فَـ⁩ it attaches itself to the following word and drops the vowel of support of the imperative: fa-tttafiq, fa- sʾal, fa-ṭlub. ʿindamā. The accent falls on ʿin-: ʿín-da-mā.

⁧منذ اثنتي عشرة سنة. عندما وصلتُ إلى إيطاليا كنت أظنّ أنّني⁩ ⁧منذ متى تُدرّسين العربية في ميلانو؟⁩

Deck A2, tag A2-14: 27 rumors. Also prepare ten cards            • complete with ⁧أَنْ⁩ / ⁧أَنَّ⁩ • 10 cards with sentences with ⁧إِذَا⁩ , on the back part with or without ⁧فَـ⁩ and explanation.
18. Unit verification

Twenty points; Exceeding at least 16. A · ⁧أَنْ⁩ / ⁧أَنَّ⁩ ( 5 points). 1. ⁧أُرِيدُ ◌ أَشْتَرِيَ سَيَّارَةً⁩ . · 2. ⁧أَعْرِفُ ◌ كَ مَشْغُولٌ⁩ . · 3. ⁧يَجِبُ ◌ تَرْجِعَ⁩ . · 4. ⁧أَظُنُّ ◌ القِطَارَ سَيَتَأَخَّرُ⁩ . · 5. Rewrite: ⁧المَكْتَبُ مُغْلَقٌ⁩ → ⁧سَمِعْتُ أَنَّ⁩ ... B · Conjunctions (7 points). Translate: 6. I didn't come because I was sick. · 7. I'll call you when I get back. · 8. When he saw me, he smiled. ( ⁧لَمَّا⁩ ) · 9. Before you go out, close the door. · 10. After he finished, he went home. · 11. While I was waiting, I read. · 12. It was late, which is why I took a cab. C · Conditions (8 points). 13. If you get lost, ask for help. · 14. If the train is late, we wait. · 15. If you don't understand, ask. · 16. If there's a fire, don't use the elevator. · 17. If he comes, I'll tell him. · 18. If you are tired (f.), stay home. · 19. Complete with or without ⁧فَـ⁩ : ⁧إِذَا جَاءَ المُدِيرُ ◌ أَخْبِرْنِي⁩ . · 20. Complete with or without ⁧فَـ⁩ : ⁧إِذَا دَرَسْتَ ◌⁩
19. To switch to the next unit

Steps to A2-15 if you have at least 16/20 and if, in a text without vowels, you can say for every ⁧أن⁩ if it is ⁧أَنْ⁩ or ⁧أَنَّ⁩ looking at the word that follows. In A2-15 return to the verbs: weak verbs at all times, than in the examples of this unity ( ⁧ضِعْتُ⁩ , ⁧يَصِلُ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَأْتِ⁩ ) you've already met.
